headline: South Korea's Kospi Jumps 6.6% Led by Semiconductor Rally
summary: South Korea's Kospi index jumped 6.63% after SK hynix reported record quarterly financial results. The surge in chipmaker equities sparked a broad domestic market rally.
why: South Korea's Kospi is heavily weighted toward semiconductor exporters Samsung Electronics and SK hynix, serving as a regional market benchmark.

impacts.name: KOSPI
impacts.why: Record quarterly results from SK hynix drove intense buying in South Korean technology stocks.

why_moved: Record earnings from memory chipmaker SK hynix triggered strong investor buying across South Korean technology stocks.
